verdict.rationale: Wave's homepage claims you can "Tag it, track it, and see what's working for your business", which loosely implies tag-based tracking. Its reports are documented only as standard statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) with month-to-month or year-to-year comparisons, with nothing on custom report building or grouping by dimension. missing for 10: a documented custom report builder, filtering or grouping reports by class, filtering or grouping by location, explicit tag-dimension reporting, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
